leadStory: Saturday, matchday eve, and the summer's cleanest exit is done: Inter Milan have confirmed Curtis Jones for €35m, the last Scouser gone to San Siro, the money now aimed at a Barcola deal Liverpool have backed with a £115m offer as PSG cut their ask toward £125m. Iraola has set his leadership group, Van Dijk captain with Alisson, Gomez and Szoboszlai as vice-captains, before Sunday's opener at Newcastle, where a thin, young side meets Isak's hostile return in red.
subject: Curtis Jones sale to Inter confirmed and the Barcola pursuit sharpening on the eve of the opener; a departure and a still-unconfirmed negotiation, not a single Liverpool hero moment already photographed
prompt: Cinematic editorial photograph, exterior of a historic English football stadium at dusk on the eve of a new season, floodlights warming against a darkening sky, empty forecourt, a mood of restless anticipation, no on-image text, generous headroom at the top for a masthead headline
